") reports its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. All amounts are in U.S. dollars unless otherwise stated.

Eshbal reported revenue of US$12.07 million for the first nine months of 2026, an increase of 19.5% compared with US$10.10 million for the same period in 2025. For the third quarter of 2026, revenue was US$3.31 million, compared with US$3.38 million in Q3 2025.

The year-over-year comparison reflects the continued evolution of Eshbal following completion of its reverse takeover in April 2025. Accordingly, the first four months of the 2025 comparative period primarily reflected Eshbal's operations prior to completion of the RTO and did not include the Company's current public-company cost structure and the launch of its North American operations.

In September 2026, Eshbal USA, which includes the Gluten Free Nation business, participated in the ECRM trade show, meeting with approximately 40 potential retail and foodservice customers. Following the show, the Company sent product samples to approximately 20 prospective customers and is in follow-up discussions with them.
The Company continued supplying its gluten-free Pita products from its Ontario manufacturing partners and continued discussions with leading Canadian retailers.
The Company developed initial samples of a powdered protein shake product designed for GLP-1 medication users.

"Over the past nine months, our focus has been on integrating our recently acquired businesses, addressing operational and commercial challenges, strengthening relationships with suppliers and customers, and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and create synergies across the Group," said Tomer Bar Meir, Chief Executive Officer of Eshbal. "While these efforts take time to translate into financial results, we expect to see the benefits of this work increasingly reflected in our performance during 2027."

The Company also announces that Nir Peles has been appointed Vice-Chair of the Board of Directors and a member of the Audit Committee, replacing Yuval Levy on the Audit Committee. The Audit Committee is now composed of Sokhie Puar (Chair), Tamir Dagan, Ifti Ifhar and Nir Peles.
"I am pleased to take on the role of Vice-Chair and to join the Audit Committee," said Nir Peles. "I look forward to working with the Board and management to support Eshbal's continued growth."

Eshbal Group is an international food group focused on developing, manufacturing, and commercializing better-for-you, gluten-free, GLP-1 friendly food products and dietary supplements. Built on more than three decades of industry experience, the Group combines product innovation, manufacturing expertise, and commercial expertise to develop and grow a portfolio of innovative health and wellness brands. The Group's strategy is to build a leading platform of health and wellness brands through organic growth, strategic acquisitions, operational excellence, and international expansion.
